abstract: # Iron Deficiency Anemia. Available from: https://nutritionguide.pcrm.org/nutritionguide/view/Nutrition\_Guide\_for\_Clinicians/1342090/all/Iron\_Deficiency\_Anemia. Consumption of any amount of alcohol is associated with a 40% reduction in the risk of iron deficiency anemia. Iron deficiency anemia is usually preventable and highly treatable.
